text:
elaine: Heads up — SylphAI onboarding goes live tomorrow morning. They asked for APAC peering + a temporary QPS bump for the pilot. Account: sylphai-prod. Contact already confirmed via email.

ravi: Got it. What numbers and IPs are we talking about?

elaine: Request is 150 QPS sustained, tolerate spikes up to 180 QPS for 48h. IPs to allowlist: 198.51.100.14/32 and 203.0.113.22/32. They want the allowlist + rate lift only for the pilot window. Also flagged this as a potential renewal risk if we can’t provision quickly.

jules: Need an expires_at for the allowlist and a rollback plan. Auto-revoke after 48h sounds right. Also add a note for the AM about SLA expectations.

anika: I'll add the renewal flag to the account and ping the AM. Tom (customer) agreed to auto-revoke, confirmed via DM.

ravi: Infra action plan: create a short-lived allowlist entry and a route-level rate_limit_override on apac-edge. Example request (we'll POST to internal admin endpoint):

```
POST /internal/admin/allowlists
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "account": "sylphai-prod",
  "ips": ["198.51.100.14/32", "203.0.113.22/32"],
  "expires_at": "2026-03-25T18:00:00Z",
  "note": "SylphAI pilot — auto-revoke after 48h"
}
```

ravi: And the rate override payload:

```
POST /internal/admin/rate_overrides
{
  "route": "apac-edge",
  "account": "sylphai-prod",
  "qps": 180,
  "duration": "48h",
  "reason": "pilot burst allowance"
}
```

deploy-bot: Provision job queued: job/678234 started for allowlist + rate override (canary deploy to apac-1).

ravi: Can confirm: rolled out to apac-1 canary. Will monitor metrics for 30m before wider rollout. Set temporary alerts: error_rate > 2% OR p95_lat > 250ms triggers auto-rollback.

elaine: :thumbsup: Please also tag this in the customer record with a note about KV-cache hints — Tom asked if we could enable caching to help costs.

anika: Done — CRM note added: "KV cache hints enabled for pilot; expect ~30% token cost reduction on repeated prompts." I also logged renewal risk and the AM has been pinged.

jules: I'll draft a tiny rollback runbook and add it to the incident playbook: steps to revoke allowlist, reset rate limit, and notify the AM + CS. Will set an automated revoke job at expiry as well.

ravi: All set for canary. If metrics look stable after 30m, we’ll push to apac-1+apac-2.

elaine: Thanks team — pls post final confirmation when pushed to both regions so I can update the customer.

jules: Will do.

(threads end)
